rows.title: Grep while saving and reading
rows.model: S12's grep and glob run off the authority, as the agent host runs them: on the page, over agent-tools' createProviderRpcFileSystem on an agent-masked composed view of a 'working-copy' bridge port the authority serves, while a 1 MiB save (S7) lands on the authority and a viewer reads one file every 20 ms there; the viewer keeps reading until the sample holds at least 40 reads, so p95 is a percentile and not the slowest read. readMax, readsDuringGrep (reads completed before grep and glob return), authorityCalls and authorityReads (what the port served) are recorded for information and never gated.
